title: First-party support inbox (replace GitHub Issues later)
description:
## Problem
Support is temporarily GitHub Issues. That is not good enough for launch customers long-term. We need a first-party support surface tracked in product data, similar to the waitlist system.

## Intent (not building yet)
- Design and implement an in-product / marketing-linked support request flow
- Persist requests in Chatticus/Anthus data (Dynamo or existing waitlist-adjacent patterns) rather than only GitHub
- Operator triage workflow for Anthus

## Out of scope for the marketing polish epic implementation
Do not implement this story in the Composer marketing PR. Keep it open as the follow-up once Privacy/Terms/Support links ship with GitHub Issues as the interim Support destination.

## Done when (future)
- Customers can submit support without a GitHub account
- Requests are stored and reviewable by operators
- Marketing Support link points at the first-party surface
